gbif.eventRemarks: My family and I have observed glow worms on this site for over sixty years. They are a regular feature of our holidays in Patterdale. Some years, we see very few, other years there are very many. Last night, my wife and i saw about ten, which , for us, is very poor!I was very interested in your site and the observations of Dorothy Wordsworth. Coincidently, this land used to be owned by William Wordsworth, but he never lived here. He and Dorothy stayed with friends in the area. He bought the land with the intention of building a house here, but never did so.I am happy to discuss this at any time.
